transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Ever since the car accident two weeks ago, I just can’t think straight or focus long enough to finish anything, even simple tasks at work. It's gotten to the point where I'm falling really far behind, and my manager is starting to notice.
Since the car accident, have you been having nightmares, flashbacks, or feeling very jumpy or on edge when something reminds you of the accident?

Yes, vivid pictures of the crash constantly pop into my head—especially the sound of the impact, the shattered glass, and the smell of burning rubber—which makes my heart race. I've also been extremely jumpy, to the point where a sudden noise like a dropped hanger at work or a car honking outside makes my whole body jerk and my heart pound.
Have these symptoms been present for more than one month since the accident, or have they mostly been limited to the past two weeks?
They've only been going on for the past two weeks, because the accident just happened two weeks ago. Everything started right after the crash and has been happening constantly since then.
Have you been feeling emotionally numb, detached from other people, or like you are in a daze or not fully aware of what is happening around you since the accident?

Yes, definitely. Sometimes everything suddenly feels weirdly far away and fake, like I'm watching a movie of my own life instead of actually being in my body. I've also been pulling away from everyone, even bailing on family gatherings because I just can't handle being around people right now.
Have you had any moments since the accident where you felt confused, disoriented, or like you could not remember parts of what happened right after the crash?

I don't have any trouble remembering the accident itself—in fact, the details are too vivid and constantly pop into my head. But I do have weird moments where I feel completely detached, like I'm watching a movie of my own life, and times at work where my mind just goes totally blank and I can't think straight.
Since the accident, do you ever feel like you are reliving the crash as if it is happening again, or like things around you are unreal or not really there?

Yes, the pictures, sounds, and smells of the crash pop into my head so vividly that my heart races and I feel like I'm right back in the driver's seat. Also, there are times when everything around me feels completely fake and far away, like I'm just watching a movie of my own life instead of actually being in my body.
Have these symptoms continued for more than one month after the accident, or are they still within the first month?
They are definitely still within the first month. The accident only happened two weeks ago, and all of this started right after the crash and has been going on constantly since then.
Have your symptoms lasted for more than one month since the accident, or are they still within the first month?

No, they haven't lasted for more than a month because the accident only happened exactly two weeks ago. All of these symptoms started right after the crash and have been going on constantly since then.
Since the accident, have you been having trouble sleeping, feeling very irritable or on edge, or having a hard time concentrating because of being constantly tense?

Yes, I've been incredibly irritable and on edge, constantly snapping at my sister and coworkers, and my concentration is so shot that I just stare blankly at emails or planograms. I also jump out of my skin at sudden noises like dropped hangers or car honks. While I haven't had specific trouble sleeping, it is almost impossible to relax because my mind and body feel constantly tense and on guard.
Have these symptoms lasted for less than one month since the accident, or have they continued for more than a month?
They have definitely lasted for less than a month, since the accident only happened two weeks ago. All of these symptoms started right after the crash and have been going on constantly since then.
Have your symptoms been getting better, staying the same, or worsening since the accident? Also, have you had any periods of feeling completely back to normal since then?

They haven't gotten any better and have just been staying the same. I haven't had any periods of feeling back to normal at all; it has been a continuous, constant struggle ever since the accident two weeks ago.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient developed acute intrusive re-experiencing, marked hyperarousal/startle, irritability, concentration problems, and depersonalization/derealization immediately after a qualifying traumatic car accident, with symptoms persisting continuously for 2 weeks and remaining within the first month. This is most consistent with acute stress reaction (ICD-10 F43.0).
